description: This file declares the OpenCDMSession class interface, which provides an abstraction for managing OpenCDM (Open Content Decryption Module) sessions, including methods for initialization, license handling, key management, and session control.

classes.name: OpenCDMSession
classes.description: An abstract class defining the interface for an OpenCDM session, including methods for license management, key handling, and session lifecycle control.

methods.name: generateRequest
methods.description: Generates a license request based on the provided initialization data type, data, and CDM data.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Updates the session with a license.

methods.name: getChallengeData
methods.description: Retrieves challenge data for license acquisition.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Checks if a key with the given key ID exists in the session.

methods.name: setDrmHeader
methods.description: Sets the DRM header for the session.

methods.name: selectKeyId
methods.description: Selects a specific key ID for the session.

methods.name: addProtectionMeta
methods.description: Adds protection metadata to a buffer, with overload for different parameters.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Retrieves the key status for a given key ID.

methods.name: getLastDrmError
methods.description: Returns the last DRM error code.
